searches.source: District of Columbia Office of the Inspector General press releases

events.summary: A community support worker at a District mental health rehabilitation provider is arraigned on September 8, 2025, accused of fraudulently billing over $234,500. The indictment alleges conduct between August 2021 and July 2023. An indictment is an allegation, not a finding. This is one person's case, not a change in policy.

scope.note: The release names community support services, not a billing code. H0036 (community psychiatric supportive treatment) stands in for community support.

source.publisher: Office of the Inspector General for the District of Columbia
source.title: Maryland Woman Arraigned for Defrauding the D.C. Medicaid Program
source.quote: Defendant Accused of Fraudulently Billing Over $234,500 in Services [...] was arraigned September 8, 2025 [...] employed by a District Mental Health Rehabilitation Service (MHRS) provider as a community support worker (CSW). [...] The indictment alleges that between August 2021 and continuing through July 2023 [...] An indictment is merely an allegation, and all defendants are presumed innocent until proven guilty beyond a reasonable doubt in a court of law.
